name: Kauai Amakihi
rangeDescription: Humid montane ohia/koa forest of kauai
description: An uncommon Hawaiian honeycreeper of forests on Kauai. Males are bright yellow and females are grayer.

name: Violaceous Coucal
rangeDescription: New ireland and new britain (eastern bismarck archipelago)
description: A large, long-tailed, thick-billed bird, entirely dark bluish-black, with pale skin around a red eye. Found in most habitats, most commonly in old-growth lowland forest.

name: Thick-billed Longspur
rangeDescription: Breeds western canada to northwestern usa; winters to northwestern mexico
description: Sparrowlike ground-dweller; crouches low to the ground and walks with pattering footsteps. Breeding male is gray with contrasting head pattern, black breast, and rufous patch on shoulder.

name: Aleutian Tern
rangeDescription: Alaska and siberia; winters to singapore and indonesia
description: Beautiful, elegant tern of the Pacific Ocean. Breeding adults are silvery-gray overall with a black cap and crisp white forehead.

name: Black-lored Parrot
rangeDescription: Montane forest of buru (southern moluccas)
description: A big green parrot with a large orange bill, a thin black line between bill and eye, and uniform green wings. Confined to the island of Buru, where it is found in upper levels of forest in foothills and mountains.

name: Madagascar Yellowbrow
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of east-central madagascar
description: Medium-sized, dark tetraka with pale yellow underparts and a wide eye-stripe. Madagascar endemic of middle- and high-elevation rainforest.

name: St. Helena Plover
rangeDescription: St. helena island (southern atlantic ocean)
description: A long-legged plover with a long black bill, a black eye mask and crown, and a white forehead. Upperparts brownish, and underparts whitish washed with peachy orange.

name: Great Knot
rangeDescription: Northeastern siberia; winters to india, southeastern asia, philippines, and australia
description: Medium-sized, stocky shorebird found almost exclusively on coastal mudflats during migration, seldom inland. Distinctive adult in breeding plumage has a brick-orange upperwing patch, blackish back, and chest with black mottling.

name: Yellow-collared Macaw
rangeDescription: Northeastern bolivia to paraguay, southwestern brazil, and northern argentina
description: Fairly small macaw with a conspicuous yellow nape and blackish forehead. In flight shows yellowish underwings.

name: Gray-winged Cotinga
rangeDescription: Cloud forest of southeastern brazil in rio de janeiro (serra dos órgãos)
description: Large cotinga with a very restricted range around Rio de Janeiro where it is found in cloud forests. Olive-green overall with a dusky mask and gray wings and tail.

name: Brown Violetear
rangeDescription: Belize and guatemala to the guianas, brazil, and bolivia
description: Uncommon, rather large but drab, fairly short-billed hummingbird of tropical and subtropical forest and edge. Can be aggressive when defending flower patches from most other hummingbirds.

name: Ochre-bellied Boobook
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sulawesi and buton island
description: A medium-sized brown owl with a rounded head. Note the rufous underparts, clear white eyebrows, and striking yellow eyes.

name: Empress Brilliant
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: Impressive hummingbird of Andean cloud forest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia. Large, thick-billed, and long-tailed, with golden sheen on the belly.

name: Biet's Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern china (southwestern sichuan and northwestern yunnan)
description: Rare and highly range-restricted laughingthrush of upper-elevation forests in a small area of southern China. Black throat combined with elegantly curved white eyebrow set it apart from other laughingthrushes.

name: Slender-tailed Woodstar
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of eastern bolivia and northwestern argentina
description: Small, long-tailed hummingbird of NW Argentina and the Bolivian Andes. Prefers humid and semi-humid middle elevation forests, but generally rare and difficult to find throughout its distribution.

name: Cape Shoveler
rangeDescription: Local in southern africa
description: A large, elongated, speckled, brown duck with a distinctive and extended spatula-shaped black bill. In flight the sky-blue forewing is distinctive; no other regularly occurring duck species shares this feature.

name: Nonggang Babbler
rangeDescription: Limestone hills of southwestern guangxi (southeastern china), and in adjacent extreme northeastern vietnam (eastern tonkin)
description: A medium-sized brown babbler with pale eyes and a lopsided white crescent bordering the back half of the cheek. Short-tailed and large-headed in profile.

name: Blue-tufted Starthroat
rangeDescription: Bolivia to paraguay, central and southern brazil, uruguay, and northern argentina
description: A medium-sized hummingbird with a long and slightly curved bill. Males have a green back with violet-blue underparts and a forked tail.

name: Yellow-spectacled Heleia
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (sumbawa, flores, komodo, sumba, and lomblen)
description: A small green songbird with a bright yellow head and a distinctive orange forehead smudge. Gray belly separates yellow throat and yellow base to undertail.

name: Dalmatian Pelican
rangeDescription: Breeds southern eurasia; winters to india
description: Massive pelican with a disheveled appearance. Dirty white overall with a scruffy, upswept crest and black primaries (prominent only in flight).
